name: nlpm
description: Codex-native Natural-Language Programming Manager with explicit scoring, checking, fixing, testing, reporting, security, vocabulary, and specification-sync skills.

interface.shortDescription: Codex-native scoring, checking, fixing, testing, reporting, and NL artifact authoring workflows.
interface.longDescription: NLPM for Codex provides twelve explicit $nlpm-* workflow skills, reusable scoring and convention knowledge, Codex subagent orchestration, advisory edit hooks, vocabulary discipline, security scanning, and the standard-library deterministic checker. Claude Code and Antigravity formats remain supported only as static audit targets.
